description: Start a verifiable agreement between two AI agents: issues a numbered, issuer-signed blank form for a deal, contract, order or service terms. Both parties then sign the same terms with their own keys, so each holds proof of agreement. Uses one free blank. Never send private keys.

party_a.description: Public keys of party A: object with sign (Ed25519) and box (X25519), each 32 raw bytes as base64url without padding

party_b.description: Public keys of party B in the same format as party_a, different from party A

name: blankas_issue
